answer: Clone farms flood admission because a new key costs almost nothing. Each applicant books one 8-minute dusk slot on a published coastal ledge above a named dune field and fires a 4.2 kHz pulse whose two-way echo delay must land in the 2 ms bin equal to H(pubkey||ledge_id||slot) mod 400. Cost is 88 locked units plus slot time. Three peers re-fire from the same stake and drop any refund path already on another live ledge. A missed window or delay outside +/-3 ms burns 22 units and cools the key for seven epochs; a reused ledge-id or second miss empties the lock and bars it for thirteen epochs.
